meetup_text_length_check.name: meetup_text_length_check
meetup_text_length_check.value: char_length("circle_meetup"."area_label") between 2 and 120 AND char_length("circle_meetup"."location_description") between 3 and 500

circle_safety_report_target_check.name: circle_safety_report_target_check
circle_safety_report_target_check.value: "circle_safety_report"."reported_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "circle_safety_report"."meetup_id" IS NOT NULL

journey_checkin_location_check.name: journey_checkin_location_check
journey_checkin_location_check.value: ("journey_check_in"."latitude" IS NULL AND "journey_check_in"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("journey_check_in"."latitude" between -90 and 90 AND "journey_check_in"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

guide_origin_scope_check.name: guide_origin_scope_check
guide_origin_scope_check.value: ("journey_guide"."origin_scope_type"='TOWN' AND "journey_guide"."origin_town_id" IS NOT NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_lga_id" IS NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_hub_id" IS NULL) OR ("journey_guide"."origin_scope_type"='LGA' AND "journey_guide"."origin_lga_id" IS NOT NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_town_id" IS NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_hub_id" IS NULL) OR ("journey_guide"."origin_scope_type"='TRAVEL_HUB' AND "journey_guide"."origin_hub_id" IS NOT NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_town_id" IS NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_lga_id" IS NULL) OR ("journey_guide"."origin_scope_type"='STATE_AREA' AND "journey_guide"."origin_state_id" IS NOT NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_town_id" IS NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_lga_id" IS NULL AND "journey_guide"."origin_hub_id" IS NULL)

guide_leg_estimates_check.name: guide_leg_estimates_check
guide_leg_estimates_check.value: ("journey_leg"."estimated_duration_minutes" IS NULL OR "journey_leg"."estimated_duration_minutes" > 0) AND ("journey_leg"."estimated_distance_km" IS NULL OR "journey_leg"."estimated_distance_km" > 0)

journey_started_check.name: journey_started_check
journey_started_check.value: "journey"."status" not in ('IN_PROGRESS','NEEDS_ATTENTION','ARRIVED','COMPLETED') OR "journey"."started_at" IS NOT NULL

journey_arrived_check.name: journey_arrived_check
journey_arrived_check.value: "journey"."status" not in ('ARRIVED','COMPLETED') OR "journey"."arrived_at" IS NOT NULL

camp_lga_requires_state.name: camp_lga_requires_state
camp_lga_requires_state.value: "orientation_camp"."lga_id" IS NULL OR "orientation_camp"."state_id" IS NOT NULL

verified_fields_check.name: verified_fields_check
verified_fields_check.value: "pcm_verification"."verification_status" <> 'VERIFIED' OR ("pcm_verification"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pcm_verification"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL)

circle_member_exit_timestamp_check.name: circle_member_exit_timestamp_check
circle_member_exit_timestamp_check.value: ("travel_circle_member"."membership_status" <> 'LEFT' OR "travel_circle_member"."left_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("travel_circle_member"."membership_status" <> 'REMOVED' OR "travel_circle_member"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL)

travel_circle_capacity_check.name: travel_circle_capacity_check
travel_circle_capacity_check.value: "travel_circle"."max_members" between 2 and 6 AND ("travel_circle"."member_count" = 0 OR "travel_circle"."member_count" between 2 and "travel_circle"."max_members")

trusted_contact_method_check.name: trusted_contact_method_check
trusted_contact_method_check.value: "trusted_contact"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "trusted_contact"."email" IS NOT NULL

trusted_contact_length_check.name: trusted_contact_length_check
trusted_contact_length_check.value: char_length("trusted_contact"."name") between 2 and 100 AND char_length("trusted_contact"."relationship") between 2 and 80
